title: Avengers: Doomsday advance bookings top 1 lakh tickets in India
headline: Avengers: Doomsday Sells ₹10 Crore+ of India Tickets in 19 Hours
caption:
Avengers: Doomsday sold more than ₹10 crore of opening-day tickets in India within about 19 hours of bookings opening, trade tracker Sacnilk reports. That is around 1 lakh tickets across PVR, INOX and Cinepolis.

For scale, Avengers: Endgame took ₹8.27 crore in its first 24 hours of advance sales at the same three chains in 2019, and Spider-Man: No Way Home ₹6.56 crore in 2021. Koimoi also reports Doomsday has passed both.

The priciest seat reported so far is a 4DX 3D midnight show at Cinepolis in Navi Mumbai: ₹4,200, or about ₹4,300 with booking fees. The film opens in Indian cinemas on Thursday, 17 December, a day before its US release.
